_comment: Data-driven panel list for the TTTR Tools toolbox. Each entry names a tool by its GUI entrypoint (module:Class); the toolbox lazily imports and instantiates it. "icon" is drawn in the navigation list in front of the name. Set "embed": true for QMainWindow tools that must be flattened into a plain panel. Add a tool by adding an entry here — no Python needed. Use {"separator": true} to group.
title: 🧰 TTTR Tools
_scope: Photon-level work on a TTTR stream. File-level operations (split/convert, header, .pto, time windows) live in File tools.

panels.name: ALEX Creator
panels.description: Convert ALEX macro-time modulation into micro-time so ALEX data runs through PIE pipelines.

panels.name: Micro-time Shifter
panels.description: Apply global and per-channel micro-time shifts to TTTR files.

panels.name: Photon Table
panels.description: Inspect the photons of a TTTR file in a table: routing channel, micro-time and macro-time, one row per photon.

panels.name: Count Rate Analysis
panels.description: Count rates per detector channel across many TTTR files, with mean/std and a per-file plot.

panels.name: Audifier
panels.description: Convert TTTR photon streams to audio, with a live micro-time / lifetime waterfall preview.
